images.title: Two urapons make an ukasar
images.purpose: Shows adding Gumulgal numbers by joining their words, with two urapons regrouped into one ukasar.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. Two dot groups joined by a plus sign on the left, an arrow, and the regrouped result on the right.
images.exact_structure: Left: one teal (#0072B2) pair of dots and one single teal dot, labelled ukasar-urapon beneath. Then a plus sign. Then one amber (#E69F00) pair of dots and one single amber dot, labelled ukasar-urapon beneath. One dark arrow pointing right. Right: three pairs of dots: one teal pair, one amber pair, and one pair made of the single teal dot and the single amber dot, ringed in reddish purple (#CC79A7) with the label new ukasar. Under the right group: ukasar-ukasar-ukasar. Exactly 6 dots on the left and 6 dots on the right. Nothing else in the frame.

images.takeaway: To add in twos, join the words and turn every two urapons into an ukasar.
images.description: Shows adding Gumulgal numbers by joining their words, with two urapons regrouped into one ukasar.
images.context: 3 + 3 = 6 shown without our numerals; practice items include (i) 9 + 7 and (iv) 16 ÷ 4 in words.

image_decisions.why: The practice concept's core move is regrouping two urapons into an ukasar while adding.
